description: Renovate covers only what Dependabot has no ecosystem for: mise.toml's tool pins, rust-toolchain.toml, and package.json's packageManager (its npm manager is enabled for that field alone). Cargo, npm, and Actions dependencies stay with .github/dependabot.yml. The two pnpm pins move in one grouped PR (scripts/checks/pnpm-pin.ts).

packageRules.description: npm dependencies belong to Dependabot; Renovate reads package.json only for packageManager.
mise.toml's pnpm and package.json's packageManager name one version.
